title: 0400486024DEC000
game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
notes: Kokiri Forest frame (docked 1x, 2560x1440): depth prepass ~700 draws (B10G11R11 RT bound, colour mask off) -> pass with foliage mesh draws (cards, grass, moss) -> shadow/AO -> lit colour pass ~500-600 draws -> fog/post at 1280x720 and 2560x1440 -> A8B8G8R8_SRGB present. Compute dispatches 4..15 right after the prepass build the GPU-driven foliage lists. Entries with only a hash came from Lichii frame dumps: the shader lab adds the program key when it sees a program with that hash (the hash matches only where Eglantine lowers the program the same way).
